dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement

controller.name: [Customer Name]
controller.description: The entity that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.

processor.name: Clutsch Inc.
processor.description: The entity that processes personal data on behalf of the Controller.

scope.description: This DPA governs the processing of personal data by Clutsch on behalf of the Customer in connection with the Clutsch unified communication dashboard service.
scope.duration: The term of the agreement between Customer and Clutsch, plus any period during which Clutsch retains personal data per the Customer's instructions.

processing_details.nature_and_purpose: AI-driven prioritization, aggregation, and summarization of communications (emails, messages, tasks) from connected platforms.
processing_details.categories_of_data_subjects: Customer's employees, contractors, and other users authorized by Customer to use the Clutsch service.
categories_of_personal_data: Message content from connected platforms (email, Slack, Teams, etc.)
OAuth tokens and integration credentials (encrypted at rest)
processing_details.special_categories_of_data: None intentionally collected. Controller is responsible for ensuring no special category data is uploaded.

obligations_of_processor.confidentiality: Clutsch ensures all personnel with access to personal data are bound by confidentiality obligations.
security_measures: Regular security audits and penetration testing
obligations_of_processor.data_breach_notification: Clutsch will notify the Controller within 48 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach.
obligations_of_processor.subprocessors: See subprocessor list below. Controller will be notified of any changes.
obligations_of_processor.data_subject_rights: Clutsch will assist the Controller in fulfilling data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability, restriction) via the API endpoints documented in the service.
obligations_of_processor.deletion_or_return: Upon termination, Clutsch will delete all personal data within 30 days unless retention is required by law.

subprocessors.name: Razorpay
subprocessors.data_processed: Billing name, email address, payment amount (no full card numbers stored)

subprocessors.name: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
subprocessors.purpose: Cloud infrastructure, data storage, and AI model inference
subprocessors.data_processed: All data processed by the Clutsch service

dpa.governing_law: This DPA shall be governed by the laws of [Jurisdiction].
